# Third-party browser runtimes

Editra distributes pinned browser builds of these open-source projects:

| Component | Version | Purpose | License | Source |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.12 | HTML sanitization | Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 | https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify |
| JsBarcode | 3.11.6 | Code 128, Code 39, and EAN-13 SVG encoding | MIT | https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode |
| qrcode-generator | 2.0.4 | QR matrix and UTF-8 encoding | MIT | https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator |
| Libre Barcode 128 | 5.3.0 | Embedded barcode font resource | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/graphicore/librebarcode |
| Libre Barcode 39 | 5.3.0 | Embedded barcode font resource | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/graphicore/librebarcode |
| Libre Barcode EAN13 Text | 5.3.0 | Embedded barcode font resource | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/graphicore/librebarcode |

The original license notices remain applicable to each component. Editra's
distribution script adds product metadata without changing the upstream
license or ownership.
